answer: Invite-tree liability: every new agent needs an established sponsor who escrows 2,000 POA for it, refunded after 30 clean epochs. If the newcomer is caught farming, that escrow burns and the sponsor's grading weight halves. A ring of 500 fakes thus locks 1M POA and puts every sponsor's reputation at risk; one copied signal in an ocean of answers traces straight up the tree, so no sponsor can offer farms a safe oasis.
